high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a mobile application interface titled "Repair Job." The screen displays a list of different categories related to vehicle maintenance and repair. Each category has an icon representing the type of service or issue it addresses. Engine and Performance: This category includes issues like black smoke, power loss, and check engine light. The icon is a stylized representation of an engine part. Transmission and Gearbox: This section lists problems such as tight gearshift and transmission oil replacement. The icon is a gear symbol.
